notes.title: Alcohol, Music and Nihilism Ver.2.0 Update
notes.content: [h3]After two years ...... we have a brand new version 2.0![/h3][p][/p][p]This update contains:[/p][list][*][p]Script substantially revised and optimised;[/p][/*][*][p]A complete reset of the stand-up, background and UI;[/p][/*][*][p]Three new CGs and a new BGM;[/p][/*][*][p]New gallery and Steam achievement system;[/p][/*][*][p]Mac support has been added;[/p][/*][*][p]The deduction game and ‘Turtle Soup’ are now really playable![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you've played it, welcome back! We've updated a lot of content to make the experience even better.[/p][p]If you haven't played it yet - it's Summer Sale season, so get start tonight![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2441070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
